text: In the simulated model, A1 (separation+cohesion+alignment, w_c 0.5) has lower post-disturbance polarization than A0 (alignment-only): Delta = -0.307, 95% CI [-0.313, -0.302], 18 cells x 20 seeds (360 pairs); rejects H0 under the frozen rule (result R-EXP002-PRIMARY)
scope: simulated 2-D model, tested grid only (N=200, rho {0.5,1,2}, eta {0.1,0.3,0.5}, r {0.5,1}, t_d 3000, W 500)
limitations: Not a recovery effect: A1 is disordered before the shock in every cell (CL-002), so Delta mostly reflects the pre-shock order level. 10 of 18 cells flagged (A0 not orderable). Per-cell differences range from -0.810 to +0.037.

text: A1 is less ordered than A0 before the shock: phi_pre A1 - A0 = -0.312, 95% CI [-0.319, -0.304]; A1 mean phi_pre 0.097 to 0.229 across the 18 cells (result R-EXP002-PHIPRE)
scope: simulated 2-D model, tested grid only (N=200, rho {0.5,1,2}, eta {0.1,0.3,0.5}, r {0.5,1}, t_d 3000, W 500)
limitations: Secondary metric, no confirmatory claim; it confounds the primary contrast (limitation 13).

text: The centralized reference A2 exceeds A0 in phi_post: A2 - A0 = 0.374, 95% CI [0.369, 0.379] (result R-EXP002-A2)
scope: simulated 2-D model, tested grid only (N=200, rho {0.5,1,2}, eta {0.1,0.3,0.5}, r {0.5,1}, t_d 3000, W 500)
limitations: A2 is an idealised global broadcast, not a local rule; its tau is 1 step by construction.

text: A1 has higher post-window cohesion (largest-component fraction) than A0, 0.080 [0.065, 0.094], and fewer collisions, -2.95 [-3.03, -2.87] per agent per 100 steps (result R-EXP002-SECONDARY)
scope: simulated 2-D model, tested grid only (N=200, rho {0.5,1,2}, eta {0.1,0.3,0.5}, r {0.5,1}, t_d 3000, W 500)

text: The sign and CI of the A1 - A0 contrast hold under topological k = 7 neighbours (S1: -0.415 [-0.429, -0.398]), cohesion 0.25 (S2a: -0.268 [-0.282, -0.257]) and 1.0 (S2b: -0.507 [-0.515, -0.498]), and reflecting walls (S3: -0.449 [-0.463, -0.434]); no condition invalidates or weakens EXP-002 (result R-EXP003-S1..S3)
scope: simulated model, reduced cells rho {0.5,2} x eta {0.1,0.5}, r 1
limitations: 4 reduced cells only; S2 pairs A1 with EXP-002 A0 runs. Magnitude grows with w_c, consistent with cohesion driving A1's disorder; the phase confound of CL-001 is not removed by any condition.

text: Recovery time tau depends on the threshold: per-cell medians at 0.8, 0.9 and 0.95 x phi_pre are tabulated for A0 and A1 from EXP-002 series (result R-EXP003-S4)
scope: simulated 2-D model, tested grid only (N=200, rho {0.5,1,2}, eta {0.1,0.3,0.5}, r {0.5,1}, t_d 3000, W 500)
limitations: tau is relative to each arm's own phi_pre, so A1's tau measures return to a disordered level; not comparable to A0's as recovery of order.
